literature.lead_zh: 美国2026年麻疹累计病例截至5月1日已超过全年预测值,四种预测模型均系统性低估疫情规模,表明当前疫情呈现与往年不同的更严重态势。
key_findings_zh: 四种预测模型(ARIMA及广义线性模型)均系统性低估了2026年累计病例数,表明疫情动态已发生根本性转变。
北卡罗来纳州超过6.5%(超41,000名)小学生未完全接种疫苗,142所学校暴发概率超过50%。
疫苗接种覆盖率每提升1个百分点,暴发相对风险约降低10%。
纽约市医疗机构2,122名接触者中未发生二次传播,可能与高免疫率及环境控制相关。
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 疫苗接种缺口扩大导致疫情超出传统模型预测能力,需重新评估暴发风险阈值和防控策略。
literature.caveats_zh: 模型预测基于历史数据,无法完全捕捉新兴变异株或免疫逃逸等新因素。
literature.headline_en: 2026 US measles outbreak exceeds all predictive model forecasts; vaccination gaps remain the core risk.
literature.lead_en: Cumulative measles cases in the US by May 1, 2026 already surpassed annual projections, with all four forecasting models systematically underestimating outbreak magnitude, indicating a fundamentally different outbreak dynamic.
key_findings_en: All four forecasting models (ARIMA and generalized linear models) systematically underpredicted 2026 cumulative cases, indicating a fundamental shift in outbreak dynamics
Over 6.5% (41,000+) elementary students in North Carolina were not fully vaccinated, with 142 schools showing >50% outbreak probability
Each 1 percentage point increase in vaccination coverage reduces relative outbreak risk by approximately 10%
No secondary transmission occurred among 2,122 healthcare contacts in NYC, likely due to high immunity rates and environmental controls
literature.trend_or_risk_en: Expanding vaccination gaps have caused the outbreak to exceed traditional model predictive capacity, requiring reassessment of outbreak risk thresholds and control strategies
literature.caveats_en: Model predictions based on historical data cannot fully capture emerging variants or new immune escape factors
literature.brief_en: 2026 US measles outbreak exceeded all model predictions, with vaccination gaps driving risk—each 1% coverage increase reduces outbreak risk by ~10%.

literature.en: Cumulative measles cases in the US by May 1, 2026 already surpassed annual projections, with all four forecasting models systematically underestimating outbreak magnitude, indicating a fundamentally different outbreak dynamic. All four forecasting models (ARIMA and generalized linear models) systematically underpredicted 2026 cumulative cases, indicating a fundamental shift in outbreak dynamics. Over 6.5% (41,000+) elementary students in North Carolina were not fully vaccinated, with 142 schools showing >50% outbreak probability. Each 1 percentage point increase in vaccination coverage reduces relative outbreak risk by approximately 10%. No secondary transmission occurred among 2,122 healthcare contacts in NYC, likely due to high immunity rates and environmental controls.

Georgia health officials confirmed three additional measles cases linked to a daycare outbreak, bringing the total to eight cases. The outbreak is associated with the measles virus, and the CDC reported 2,700 measles cases nationwide in 2026, the highest in recent history. [news-c7f01e04d918823f]

Measles infections have reached a 35-year high in the United States, with over 3,000 cases reported nationwide. A public health expert, Tyler Evans, warned that vaccine hesitancy, including signals from federal officials, is fueling the outbreak. [news-e764f2a0fca30835]

Two infants died from measles in Pennsylvania, confirmed by the state’s coroner, and the U.S. has reached a 35-year high of 3,134 confirmed measles cases. The CDC is monitoring the situation, and the U.S. may lose its measles elimination status. [news-ea60535cd3786ec4]

Wisconsin DHS reported an ongoing measles outbreak, urging families to check their children's vaccination status. The outbreak includes confirmed and probable cases, with two hospitalizations. [news-0e5e939cf9eadc48]

papers.title: The prevalence of measles vaccination in measles-infected healthcare workers: A systematic review and meta-analysis
papers.abstract: AIMS: Documentable evidence of previous receipt of 2-dose of measles-containing vaccine (MCV) is often sufficient as proof of measles immunity in healthcare workers (HCWs). The usefulness of this policy was assessed by estimating the global prevalences of different MCV-receipt statuses in measles infected HCWs. METHODS: Eligible publications since 1974 were searched in PubMed, Embase, and Scopus databases. Pooled prevalences were estimated by prevalence meta-analysis and meta-regressed using durations since MCV inclusion in the national immunization schedule (NIS) of respective study countries to measles outbreak years as a moderator. RESULTS: Of the 7571 citations retrieved, 27 studies reporting on 1319 measles-infected HCWs aged 18-60 years (outbreak years: 1985-2019) were reviewed. Prevalences of measles-infected HCWs were- a. by gender: females: 65.0% (95% CI: 57.0, 72.0); males: 35.0% (95% CI: 28.0, 43.0); c. by birth year: born after MCV inclusion in NIS: 77.0% (95% CI: 66.0, 87.0) and in born before: 6.0% (95% CI: 0.0, 17.0); d. by health profession: nurses: 31.0% (95% CI: 24.0, 39.0); doctors: 27.0% (95% CI: 19.0, 36.0); students 5.0% (95% CI: 1.0, 12.0). The measles risk in ≥2-dose of MCV recipient HCWs increased with duration since MCV inclusion in NIS to outbreak occurrences (p < .05). CONCLUSION: In measles infected HCWs, as the rates of being ≥2-dose MCV recipient or unvaccinated were substantial and comparable, the role of documented 2-dose of MCV receipt alone as a proof of measles immunity remains uncertain.

papers.title: Measles Frontline Defense: The Pivotal Role of Emergency Nurses and Emergency Medical Services Personnel
papers.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Measles was declared eliminated in the United States in 2000. However, in 2025, the country experienced the highest number of cases reported in more than 2 decades. Furthermore, early 2026 data from the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention indicate a continued increase in case counts. Emergency nurses and emergency medical technicians frequently serve as the initial health care professionals who assess patients with fever and rashes. Prompt identification and swift isolation are essential to curtail measles transmission. This narrative literature review aims to provide practical, evidence-based guidance for emergency nurses and emergency medical technicians on the recognition, isolation, documentation, infection control, and coordination with public health authorities during measles outbreaks. METHODS: A narrative review synthesizing current Centers for Disease Control and Prevention and World Health Organization guidance was conducted. Peer-reviewed literature was identified through targeted searches in PubMed and Google Scholar using keywords, including measles, emergency department, prehospital, emergency nurse, emergency medical services, triage, and infection control, focusing on publications from 2015 to 2026. Studies providing practical guidance or epidemiologic data relevant to emergency medical settings were prioritized. RESULTS: Measles spreads through airborne transmission and can remain suspended in the air for up to 2 hours after an infected individual leaves an area. Early symptoms include fever, cough, coryza (runny nose and nasal congestion), and conjunctivitis, followed by a descending maculopapular rash (red rash with both flat areas and small bumps on the skin), which typically begins on the face and spreads downward. Proper triage assessment, infection-control measures, documentation within electronic health records, and timely communication with infection prevention and public health authorities are essential to interrupt the transmission. DISCUSSION: Measles remains one of the most contagious viral illnesses encountered in health care settings. Emergency nurses and emergency medical technicians are often the first to recognize and halt the spread of measles. Clear triage and screening steps should be used, staff immunity should be confirmed, and close collaboration with infection prevention and public health teams is necessary to protect patients, families, and health care workers.

analysis.summary_en: Measles, declared eliminated in the United States in 2000 (A1), has re‐emerged with the highest case count in over 20 years (A2) and continues to rise in early 2026 (A3). The virus spreads via airborne transmission that can persist for up to two hours (A10) and presents with fever, cough, coryza, conjunctivitis, and a descending maculopapular rash (A11). Emergency nurses and emergency medical technicians are often the first to encounter these signs (A4) and must promptly identify, isolate, and implement infection‐control measures to curb spread (A5, A12). A narrative literature review synthesizing CDC and WHO guidance (A7) searched PubMed and Google Scholar for 2015‐2026 publications on measles in emergency settings (A8) and prioritized practical guidance (A9). Consensus emphasizes that early triage, isolation, documentation, staff immunity verification, and coordinated communication with public‐health authorities are essential to interrupt transmission (A12, A13, A14, A15). Evidence gaps include limited data on optimal emergency triage and surveillance strategies despite the ongoing increase in cases (A2, A3, A15). Future priorities focus on developing and validating emergency‐department triage algorithms, ensuring staff immunity, strengthening infection‐control practices, and enhancing real‐time surveillance to protect patients, families, and health‐care workers.

papers.abstract_zh: 简介:麻疹 于 2000 年在美国宣布消除。然而,2025 年,该国报告的病例数达到了 20 多年来的最高水平。此外,疾病控制与预防中心 2026 年初的数据表明病例数持续增加。急诊护士和急诊医疗技术人员经常作为最初的医疗保健专业人员来评估发烧和皮疹患者。及时识别和迅速隔离对于遏制 麻疹 传播 至关重要。这篇叙述性文献综述旨在为急诊护士和急诊医疗技术人员在 麻疹 暴发 期间的识别、隔离、记录、感染控制以及与公共卫生当局的协调方面提供实用的、基于证据的指导。方法:进行了综合当前疾病控制与预防中心和世界卫生组织指南的叙述性回顾。通过使用 麻疹、急诊科、院前、急诊护士、紧急医疗服务、分诊和感染控制等关键词在 PubMed 和 Google Scholar 中进行有针对性的搜索来确定同行评审文献,重点关注 2015 年至 2026 年的出版物。优先考虑提供与紧急医疗环境相关的实用指导或流行病学数据的研究。结果:麻疹 通过空气中的 传播 传播,并在感染者离开某个区域后可在空气中悬浮长达 2 小时。早期症状包括发烧、咳嗽、鼻炎(流鼻涕和鼻塞)和结膜炎,随后出现下降的斑丘疹(皮肤上有平坦区域和小肿块的红色皮疹),通常从面部开始并向下蔓延。适当的分诊评估、感染控制措施、电子健康记录中的记录以及与感染预防和公共卫生当局的及时沟通对于中断 传播 至关重要。讨论:麻疹 仍然是医疗保健环境中最具传染性的病毒性疾病之一。急诊护士和急救医疗技术人员往往是最先识别并阻止 麻疹 传播的人。应采用明确的分类和筛查步骤,应确认工作人员的免疫力,并与感染预防和公共卫生团队密切合作,以保护患者、家庭和医护人员。

papers.title: Measles Vaccine Boosters in Immunocompromised Adults to Reduce Morbidity and Mortality From Acute Measles Infection: A Scoping Review
papers.abstract: Measles is a highly contagious viral illness associated with significant global mortality, despite the availability of an effective vaccine.As vaccine hesitancy continues to increase following the COVID-19 pandemic, combined with a lack of measles-specific antiviral agents, the risk of outbreaks and epidemics remains elevated.Immunocompromised individuals have a higher risk of serious complications from measles, especially because the live-attenuated measles, mumps, and rubella vaccine may be contraindicated in severely immunocompromised patients.As such, these individuals depend on herd immunity.This scoping review aims to identify the potential need for a measles booster dose among immunocompromised adults in the United States by providing an overview of current vaccine indications and outcomes.EMBASE, Web of Science, and Ovid MEDLINE were searched using search terms specific to measles booster doses and immunocompromised adults.In total, 2,335 articles were imported to Rayyan, and after a two-tiered review, seven articles met the full inclusion criteria.The results revealed that individuals with chronic immunocompromising illnesses were often not fully protected against measles, leaving them vulnerable to infection.The findings from this review suggest that clinicians may consider a booster dose of vaccine for immunocompromised individuals to help restore their protection against measles.Meanwhile, further research utilizing larger sample sizes and diverse patient populations is warranted based on these findings.We believe that additional studies should aim to clarify current guidelines to improve the care of immunocompromised patients who may be exposed to measles.

elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 尽管存在有效的 疫苗,但 麻疹 是一种与全球重大 死亡率 相关的高度传染性病毒性疾病。随着 COVID-19 大流行后,疫苗 的犹豫不断增加,加上缺乏 麻疹 特异性 抗病毒药物 药物,麻疹 和流行病的风险仍然存在免疫功能低下的个体因 麻疹 出现严重并发症的风险较高,特别是因为严重免疫功能低下的患者可能禁忌使用减毒活疫苗 麻疹、腮腺炎和风疹 疫苗。因此,这些个体依赖群体免疫。本次范围界定审查旨在确定免疫功能低下患者对 麻疹 加强剂量的潜在需求通过提供当前 疫苗 适应症和结果的概述,对美国成人进行了搜索。使用特定于 麻疹 加强剂量和免疫功能低下成人的搜索词对 EMBASE、Web of Science 和 Ovid MEDLINE 进行了搜索。Rayyan 总共导入了 2,335 篇文章,经过两级审查后,有 7 篇文章符合完全纳入标准。结果显示,患有慢性免疫功能低下疾病的个体往往没有得到充分的保护麻疹,使他们容易受到感染。本次综述的结果表明,临床医生可以考虑对免疫功能低下个体进行 麻疹 加强剂量,以帮助他们恢复对 麻疹 的保护。同时,根据这些发现,有必要利用更大的样本量和不同的患者群体进行进一步的研究。我们认为,其他研究应该旨在澄清当前的指南,以改善可能接触 麻疹 的免疫功能低下患者的护理麻疹。

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to describe a newly recognized slow myoclonic pattern associated with Subacute Sclerosing Panencephalitis (SSPE), a progressive neurological disorder caused by measles virus infection. The authors sought to highlight the clinical and electroencephalographic features of this pattern.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study is a case series involving three patients with SSPE, including a 20-year-old woman with Jabbour Stage III disease. The cases were observed over an eight-month period, with detailed clinical and EEG findings documented.
analysis.methods: The authors conducted clinical observations and electroencephalography (EEG) to document the myoclonic patterns. They described the periodic myoclonic jerks, including their timing, associated movements, and the EEG findings of triphasic long-interval periodic discharges (Radermecker complexes).
analysis.main_results: The first case showed periodic, brisk eyelid openings associated with frontalis contraction, followed by slow eyelid closure due to delayed relaxation of the levator palpebrae superioris. These movements were time-locked to Radermecker complexes on EEG, and were distinct from normal blinks.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret these findings as evidence of a newly recognized slow myoclonic pattern in SSPE, which involves multiple cranial nerves and brainstem motor nuclei. This pattern is distinct from typical myoclonic jerks and normal blinks.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings contribute to the understanding of SSPE's clinical manifestations, potentially aiding in the diagnosis and differential diagnosis of neurological conditions associated with measles virus infection.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to a single case series, which may not be representative of all SSPE cases. However, the detailed clinical and EEG observations provide a strong foundation for further research into this newly recognized pattern.

analysis.summary_en: This study presents a case series of three patients with Subacute Sclerosing Panencephalitis (SSPE) who exhibited a newly recognized slow myoclonic pattern involving eyelid movements. The first case, a 20-year-old woman with Jabbour Stage III SSPE, showed periodic, brisk eyelid openings associated with frontalis contraction, followed by slow eyelid closure due to delayed relaxation of the levator palpebrae superioris. These movements were time-locked to triphasic long-interval periodic discharges (Radermecker complexes) on electroencephalography (EEG), distinguishing them from normal blinks. The authors interpret these findings as evidence of a distinct slow myoclonic pattern in SSPE, involving multiple cranial nerves and brainstem motor nuclei. This observation may enhance the clinical and EEG-based understanding of SSPE, aiding in its diagnosis and differential diagnosis. The study's limitations include its reliance on a single case series, which may not capture the full spectrum of SSPE manifestations. Despite this, the detailed clinical and EEG findings provide a solid basis for further investigation into this pattern.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在描述一种新发现的与 亚急性硬化性全脑炎 (SSPE) 相关的缓慢肌阵挛模式,亚急性硬化性全脑炎 是一种由 麻疹病毒 感染引起的进行性神经系统疾病。作者试图强调这种模式的临床和脑电图特征。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究是一个病例系列,涉及三名 SSPE 患者,其中包括一名患有 Jabbour III 期疾病的 20 岁女性。这些病例经过八个月的观察,并记录了详细的临床和脑电图检查结果。
analysis_zh.methods: 作者进行了临床观察和脑电图(EEG)来记录肌阵挛模式。他们描述了周期性肌阵挛性抽搐,包括其时间、相关运动以及三相长间隔周期性放电(Radermecker 复合波)的脑电图发现。
analysis_zh.main_results: 第一个病例表现出与额肌收缩相关的周期性、轻快的眼睑张开,随后由于上睑提肌延迟松弛而导致眼睑缓慢闭合。这些动作与脑电图上的 Radermecker 复合体时间锁定,并且与正常的眨眼不同。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为新认识的 SSPE 慢肌阵挛模式的证据,该模式涉及多个脑神经和脑干运动核。这种模式与典型的肌阵挛性抽搐和正常的眨眼不同。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现有助于理解 SSPE 的临床表现,可能有助于 诊断 和 麻疹病毒 感染相关神经系统疾病的鉴别 麻疹病毒。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于单个病例系列,可能无法代表所有 SSPE 病例。然而,详细的临床和脑电图观察为进一步研究这种新认识的模式提供了坚实的基础。

papers.title: Serological Protection After Routine Measles-Containing Vaccination Among Children Aged 1–5 Years in Low- and Middle-Income Countries: A Systematic Review
papers.abstract: Background: Measles remains a major cause of morbidity and mortality among children in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs), despite widespread implementation of routine two-dose measles-containing vaccine (MCV) schedules. Serological assessment provides an objective measure of vaccine-induced immunity; however, evidence describing post-vaccination serological protection among children in LMICs remains fragmented and methodologically heterogeneous. Objective: To synthesize evidence on serological protection following routine two-dose MCV among children aged 1–5 years in LMICs and to identify determinants of immunity, methodological limitations, and evidence gaps relevant to immunization programmes. Methods: This systematic review was conducted in accordance with the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA 2020) guidelines and prospectively registered in PROSPERO (CRD420261300545). Literature searches were conducted in PubMed, MEDLINE, Scopus, Cochrane Library, CINAHL (EBSCO), and SciSpace on 21 January 2026. Two reviewers independently screened studies, extracted data, and assessed quality of evidence using Joanna Briggs Institute critical appraisal tools. Substantial clinical and methodological heterogeneity precluded meta-analysis; therefore, findings were synthesized narratively. Results: Eighteen studies met the eligibility. These studies were from 14 LMICs across four WHO regions (61.1% African Region, 27.8% Eastern Mediterranean Region, 5.6% each South-East Asia and the region of the Americas). Reported MCV seroprotection following completion of the two-dose schedule generally ranged from 30.6% to 100%, with the highest levels (87–100%), but with evident lower protection in specific settings, such as rural Pakistan (30.6%) and Ethiopia (40–54%) despite having documented vaccination records. Lower protection was consistently associated with undernutrition, human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) infection, incomplete or delayed vaccination, younger age at first dose, and weak programme performance. Considerable variability was observed in study design, vaccination schedules, laboratory assays (ELISA, PRNT, haemagglutination inhibition, and others), seroprotective thresholds, timing of antibody assessment, and participant characteristics. Risk of bias was largely moderate-to-high, and certainty of evidence ranged from low to very low. Conclusions: Routine two-dose measles vaccination generally provides substantial serological protection among children aged 1–5 years in LMICs. Nevertheless, methodological heterogeneity and geographical evidence gaps limit direct comparisons and reduce confidence in cross-study interpretation. Greater standardization of serological assessment and thresholds, harmonized reporting methods, and well-designed longitudinal studies are needed to strengthen the evidence base and support immunization policies aimed at achieving and sustaining measles elimination.

analysis.summary_en: This systematic review evaluates serological protection following routine two-dose measles-containing vaccination among children aged 1–5 years in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs). Despite widespread vaccination, evidence on post-vaccination immunity remains fragmented and methodologically diverse. The review identifies significant variability in study design, vaccination schedules, laboratory assays, and seroprotective thresholds, which precluded meta-analysis. Key findings indicate that seroprotection generally ranges from 30.6% to 100%, with lower protection observed in specific settings like rural Pakistan and Ethiopia. Factors associated with reduced protection include undernutrition, HIV infection, incomplete vaccination, younger age at first dose, and weak programme performance. The review highlights the need for standardized serological assessment, harmonized reporting, and longitudinal studies to improve the evidence base and guide immunization policies toward measles elimination.

analysis_en.scope_and_question: Measles remains a major cause of morbidity and mortality among children in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs), despite widespread implementation of routine two-dose measles-containing vaccine (MCV) schedules. To synthesize evidence on serological protection following routine two-dose MCV among children aged 1–5 years in LMICs and to identify determinants of immunity, methodological limitations, and evidence gaps relevant to immunization programmes.
analysis_en.evidence_base_and_review_method: This systematic review was conducted in accordance with the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA 2020) guidelines and prospectively registered in PROSPERO (CRD420261300545). Literature searches were conducted in PubMed, MEDLINE, Scopus, Cochrane Library, CINAHL (EBSCO), and SciSpace on 21 January 2026. Two reviewers independently screened studies, extracted data, and assessed quality of evidence using Joanna Briggs Institute critical appraisal tools. Substantial clinical and methodological heterogeneity precluded meta-analysis; therefore, findings were synthesized narratively.
analysis_en.consensus_and_key_conclusions: Routine two-dose measles vaccination generally provides substantial serological protection among children aged 1–5 years in LMICs. Reported MCV seroprotection following completion of the two-dose schedule generally ranged from 30.6% to 100%, with the highest levels (87–100%), but with evident lower protection in specific settings, such as rural Pakistan (30.6%) and Ethiopia (40–54%) despite having documented vaccination records.
analysis_en.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: Considerable variability was observed in study design, vaccination schedules, laboratory assays (ELISA, PRNT, haemagglutination inhibition, and others), seroprotective thresholds, timing of antibody assessment, and participant characteristics. Risk of bias was largely moderate-to-high, and certainty of evidence ranged from low to very low.
analysis_en.research_and_practice_implications: Lower protection was consistently associated with undernutrition, human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) infection, incomplete or delayed vaccination, younger age at first dose, and weak programme performance. Greater standardization of serological assessment and thresholds, harmonized reporting methods, and well-designed longitudinal studies are needed to strengthen the evidence base and support immunization policies aimed at achieving and sustaining measles elimination.

papers.title_zh: 常规含麻疹的疫苗接种接种后儿童1–5岁群体的血清学保护:一项系统综述
papers.source_body_en: Background: Measles remains a major cause of morbidity and mortality among children in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs), despite widespread implementation of routine two-dose measles-containing vaccine (MCV) schedules. Serological assessment provides an objective measure of vaccine-induced immunity; however, evidence describing post-vaccination serological protection among children in LMICs remains fragmented and methodologically heterogeneous. Objective: To synthesize evidence on serological protection following routine two-dose MCV among children aged 1–5 years in LMICs and to identify determinants of immunity, methodological limitations, and evidence gaps relevant to immunization programmes. Methods: This systematic review was conducted in accordance with the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA 2020) guidelines and prospectively registered in PROSPERO (CRD420261300545). Literature searches were conducted in PubMed, MEDLINE, Scopus, Cochrane Library, CINAHL (EBSCO), and SciSpace on 21 January 2026. Two reviewers independently screened studies, extracted data, and assessed quality of evidence using Joanna Briggs Institute critical appraisal tools. Substantial clinical and methodological heterogeneity precluded meta-analysis; therefore, findings were synthesized narratively. Results: Eighteen studies met the eligibility. These studies were from 14 LMICs across four WHO regions (61.1% African Region, 27.8% Eastern Mediterranean Region, 5.6% each South-East Asia and the region of the Americas). Reported MCV seroprotection following completion of the two-dose schedule generally ranged from 30.6% to 100%, with the highest levels (87–100%), but with evident lower protection in specific settings, such as rural Pakistan (30.6%) and Ethiopia (40–54%) despite having documented vaccination records. Lower protection was consistently associated with undernutrition, human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) infection, incomplete or delayed vaccination, younger age at first dose, and weak programme performance. Considerable variability was observed in study design, vaccination schedules, laboratory assays (ELISA, PRNT, haemagglutination inhibition, and others), seroprotective thresholds, timing of antibody assessment, and participant characteristics. Risk of bias was largely moderate-to-high, and certainty of evidence ranged from low to very low. Conclusions: Routine two-dose measles vaccination generally provides substantial serological protection among children aged 1–5 years in LMICs. Nevertheless, methodological heterogeneity and geographical evidence gaps limit direct comparisons and reduce confidence in cross-study interpretation. Greater standardization of serological assessment and thresholds, harmonized reporting methods, and well-designed longitudinal studies are needed to strengthen the evidence base and support immunization policies aimed at achieving and sustaining measles elimination.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景:尽管在低收入和中等收入国家(LMICs)广泛实施了常规两剂含麻疹的疫苗(MCV)接种计划,麻疹仍然是导致儿童发病率和死亡率的主要原因。血清学评估提供了对疫苗诱导免疫的客观衡量;然而,关于LMICs中儿童完成两剂疫苗接种后血清学保护的证据仍较为零散且方法学不一致。目标:综合分析LMICs中1–5岁儿童常规两剂MCV接种后血清学保护的证据,并识别与免疫接种计划相关的免疫决定因素、方法学局限性和证据缺口。方法:本系统综述遵循首选报告项目清单(PRISMA 2020)指南,并在PROSPERO(CRD420261300545)前瞻性注册。文献检索于2026年1月21日在PubMed、MEDLINE、Scopus、Cochrane Library、CINAHL(EBSCO)和SciSpace数据库中进行。两名评审员独立筛选研究、提取数据并使用Joanna Briggs Institute的批判性评价工具评估证据质量。由于临床和方法学上的显著异质性,无法进行元分析;因此,结果以叙述性方式综合。结果:共有18项研究符合纳入标准。这些研究来自四个世界卫生组织地区中的14个LMICs(61.1%来自非洲地区,27.8%来自东地中海地区,南亚和美洲地区各占5.6%)。完成两剂接种计划后,报告的MCV血清保护率通常在30.6%至100%之间,最高水平为87–100%,但在某些特定环境中,如农村巴基斯坦(30.6%)和埃塞俄比亚(40–54%),尽管有记录的疫苗接种接种,仍显示出明显的较低保护水平。较低的保护水平与营养不良、人类免疫缺陷病毒(HIV)感染、不完整或延迟的疫苗接种接种、首次接种年龄较小以及免疫接种计划执行不力等因素密切相关。研究设计、疫苗接种接种计划、实验室检测方法(如ELISA、PRNT、凝集抑制试验等)、血清保护阈值、抗体检测时间点以及受试者特征等方面存在显著差异。偏倚风险总体为中等至高,证据确定性从低到非常低不等。结论:常规两剂含麻疹的疫苗接种接种通常在LMICs中1–5岁儿童中提供显著的血清学保护。然而,方法学异质性和地理证据缺口限制了直接比较,并降低了跨研究解释的置信度。需要更大的血清学评估标准化、统一的报告方法以及设计良好的纵向研究,以加强证据基础并支持旨在实现和维持麻疹消除的免疫接种政策。

papers.title: Multiple Measles Transmission Events Associated With a Single Traveler Arriving in the United States, May 2025.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Travelers who fly on commercial aircraft while infectious with measles are reported to the US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) by health departments. CDC contacts airlines to collect information on potentially exposed travelers. Traveler locating information is shared with health departments to facilitate aircraft contact investigations. In May 2025, CDC was notified of a traveler who flew from Europe to Colorado while infectious with measles, transited through Denver International Airport, then flew from Colorado to North Dakota. This report describes details of the subsequent contact investigations, environmental assessment, and laboratory testing results. METHODS: CDC laboratories conducted testing on a majority of case samples. Data from the CDC laboratory, CDC's Port Health Activity Reporting System, and health department investigations were analyzed to describe the index case, contacts, test results, and travel details. Flight records and visual inspection were used to describe relative locations of index and secondary case-patients at Denver International Airport. RESULTS: The index case was in an unvaccinated adult. Aircraft contact investigations identified 135 exposed domestic travelers. Fifteen secondary cases were identified among people exposed during the international (5) and domestic (3) flights and at the airport (7). Two tertiary case-patients were also identified. Five of the secondary case-patients had at least 1 documented prior measles vaccination. CONCLUSIONS: Measles transmission may occur during travel. Measles vaccination is recommended prior to international travel for all travelers aged 6 months or older. Travelers with fever and other overt signs of transmissible illness, such as coughing or malaise, should be strongly encouraged to delay travel while symptomatic.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to investigate measles transmission events linked to a single traveler arriving in the United States in May 2025, highlighting the potential for measles to spread during travel and the importance of identifying and managing such cases.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study involved contact investigations, environmental assessments, and laboratory testing following the arrival of an unvaccinated adult with measles in Colorado, who transited through Denver International Airport and then traveled to North Dakota. A total of 135 domestic travelers were identified as potentially exposed.
analysis.methods: CDC laboratories conducted testing on case samples, and data from the CDC laboratory, CDC's Port Health Activity Reporting System, and health department investigations were analyzed to describe the index case, contacts, test results, and travel details. Flight records and visual inspection were used to determine the relative locations of the index and secondary case-patients at Denver International Airport.
analysis.main_results: The index case was an unvaccinated adult. A total of 15 secondary cases were identified among people exposed during the international (5) and domestic (3) flights and at the airport (7). Two tertiary case-patients were also identified.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that measles transmission may occur during travel, emphasizing the need for vigilance in identifying and managing infectious cases among travelers. This case report provides a novel example of measles transmission linked to a single traveler's itinerary.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings highlight the importance of measles vaccination prior to international travel and the necessity of monitoring travelers with fever and other signs of transmissible illness to prevent further spread of the virus.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on a single case report and does not provide statistical evidence or broader generalizability. However, the evidence is strong due to the detailed contact investigations and laboratory testing conducted.

analysis.summary_en: This study describes a measles transmission event associated with a single unvaccinated traveler arriving in the United States in May 2025. The traveler, who flew from Europe to Colorado and then to North Dakota, was infectious during travel, leading to contact investigations that identified 135 exposed domestic travelers and 15 secondary cases. Two tertiary cases were also found. The report underscores the potential for measles to spread during travel and the importance of vaccination prior to international travel. It also recommends that travelers with fever and other symptoms of transmissible illness should delay travel. The study is based on a single case and relies on contact tracing and laboratory testing, which provide strong evidence but limit generalizability.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在调查与2025年5月一名旅行者抵达美国相关的麻疹 传播事件,强调麻疹在旅行期间传播的潜在风险以及识别和管理此类病例的重要性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究涉及一名未接种疫苗的 麻疹 成年人抵达科罗拉多州后进行的接触调查、环境评估和实验室检测,该成年人经丹佛国际机场转机,然后前往北达科他州。共有 135 名国内旅客被确定为潜在暴露者。
elements_zh.methods: 疾控中心实验室对病例样本进行了检测,并对来自疾控中心实验室、疾控中心港口卫生活动报告系统和卫生部门调查的数据进行了分析,以描述指示病例、接触者、检测结果和旅行详细信息。使用飞行记录和目视检查来确定丹佛国际机场的索引患者和次要病例患者的相对位置。
elements_zh.main_results: 指示病例是一名未接种疫苗的成年人。在国际 (5) 次、国内 (3) 航班和机场 (7) 期间暴露的人群中,总共发现了 15 例继发病例。还确定了两名三级病例患者。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,麻疹 传播可能在旅行期间发生,强调在识别和管理旅行者中的感染病例时需要保持警惕。此 病例报告 提供了链接到单个旅行者行程的 麻疹 传播 的新颖示例。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调了在国际旅行前进行 麻疹 疫苗接种 的重要性,以及监测有发烧和其他传染性疾病迹象的旅行者的必要性,以防止病毒进一步传播。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究基于单个 病例报告,不提供统计证据或更广泛的普遍性。然而,由于进行了详细的接触调查和实验室测试,证据确凿。

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:乘坐商用飞机的旅客感染 麻疹 后,卫生部门会向美国疾病控制与预防中心 (CDC) 报告。CDC 联系航空公司收集有关潜在暴露旅客的信息。旅客定位信息会与卫生部门共享,以方便飞机接触情况调查。2025 年 5 月,CDC 接到通知,一名感染 麻疹 的旅客从欧洲飞往科罗拉多州,经丹佛国际机场转机,然后从科罗拉多州飞往北达科他州。该报告描述了后续接触调查、环境评估和实验室检测结果的详细信息。方法:CDC 实验室对大多数病例样本进行了检测。对来自 CDC 实验室、CDC 港口卫生活动报告系统和卫生部门调查的数据进行了分析,以描述指示病例、接触者、检测结果和旅行详细信息。飞行记录和目视检查用于描述丹佛国际机场索引患者和继发病例患者的相对位置。结果:指示病例是一名未接种疫苗的成年人。飞机接触调查发现 135 名国内旅客受到感染。在国际 (5) 和国内 (3) 航班以及在机场 (7) 期间暴露的人群中发现了 15 例继发病例。还确定了两名三级病例患者。其中 5 名次要病例患者至少有 1 份既往记录的 麻疹 疫苗接种。结论:麻疹 传播 可能在旅行期间发生。麻疹 建议所有 6 个月或以上的旅客在国际旅行前使用 麻疹。应强烈鼓励出现发烧和其他明显传染性疾病症状(例如咳嗽或不适)的旅客在出现症状时推迟旅行。

papers.title: Characterizing measles healthcare facility exposures—December 2023–September 2025—New York City
papers.abstract: Abstract Background When people develop measles (cases), healthcare facility exposures are common and result in many potentially exposed people requiring resource-intensive control measures. We summarized exposures and transmission among people exposed to measles (contacts) in healthcare settings in New York City (NYC). Methods NYC Health Department’s surveillance data of NYC contacts exposed to measles cases in any NYC healthcare facility during December 2023–September 2025 was analyzed as a retrospective descriptive study. Characteristics summarized included measles transmission, immunity status, post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) administration, facility setting, and time of measles exposure. Results Of 2,122 healthcare contacts to 28 cases, no secondary cases occurred. 1,285 (60.6%) were vaccinated or had other evidence of immunity, 618 (29.1%) were adults with unknown immunity, 124 (5.8%) were not immune and received PEP, and 95 (4.5%) were not immune and did not receive PEP. Most contacts were exposed in emergency departments and/or hospital inpatient settings (1,406; 66.3%). Among 1,028 contacts with known time of exposure (48.4% of all contacts), 785 (76.4%) overlapped with the case in the healthcare facility, 146 (14.2%) arrived within 1 hour and 97 (9.4%) arrived 1–2 hours after the case left or was isolated. Conclusions Most contacts exposed to measles in NYC healthcare facilities had presumptive immunity or were adults with unknown immunity. No transmission occurred among 2,122 exposed contacts, including non-immune contacts. Given no secondary transmission and resource-intensive control measures, relying solely on time-based measles exposure definitions may be overly broad. Incorporating strategies like facility air exchange data might better assess transmission risk.

analysis.summary_en: This study analyzed measles healthcare facility exposures in New York City from December 2023 to September 2025. It aimed to understand the characteristics of contacts and assess transmission risk. The study found that among 2,122 contacts, no secondary cases occurred, and most had immunity or were adults with unknown immunity. The study's retrospective design and reliance on surveillance data provide moderate confidence in its conclusions.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 摘要 背景 当人们感染 麻疹(病例)时,医疗机构暴露较为常见,导致许多潜在暴露者需要资源密集型的控制措施。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 我们总结了纽约市 (NYC) 医疗机构中接触 麻疹(接触者)的人群的暴露情况和 传播。
elements_zh.methods: 方法 作为一项回顾性描述性研究,对 2023 年 12 月至 2025 年 9 月期间在任何纽约市医疗机构中接触过 麻疹 病例的纽约市接触者的纽约市卫生局 麻疹 数据进行了分析。
elements_zh.main_results: 结果 2,122 名医疗接触者中 28 例,无继发病例发生。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 结论 纽约市医疗机构中接触 麻疹 的大多数接触者具有推测性免疫或为免疫状态未知的成年人。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 鉴于没有出现二级 传播 且需要资源密集型控制措施,仅依赖基于时间的 麻疹 暴露定义可能过于宽泛。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 在 2,122 名暴露接触者中,包括无免疫力接触者,均未出现 传播。

papers.title: Timeliness of measles vaccination in selected districts of Oromia Region, Ethiopia – 2021
papers.abstract: Background Delays in vaccination with the first/s dose of measles-containing vaccine (MCV1, MCV2) increases risk of measles transmission. MCV2 was added to Ethiopia's routine immunization schedule in 2019, administered at age 15 months. We describe age at measles vaccination and characteristics associated with timely vaccination following MCV2 introduction. Methods A secondary analysis from a 2021 cross-sectional household survey of children aged 12–35 months in Oromia, Ethiopia was conducted. MCV vaccination status and age at vaccination were determined from the child's vaccination card. The cumulative card-confirmed vaccination coverage of MCV1 and MCV2 (among children 24–35 months) by age at vaccination was estimated. Among children who received MCV, vaccination timing was classified as early (MCV1: <9 months; MCV2: <15 months), timely (MCV1: 9 to <10 months; MCV2: 15 to <16 months), or delayed (MCV1: ≥10 months; MCV2: ≥16 months). Characteristics associated with timely MCV1 vaccination were analyzed using multivariate logistic regression, with urban/rural stratification. Results Overall, 651 children aged 12–35 months (MCV1) and a subset of 270 children aged 24–35 months (MCV2) were analyzed. Cumulative MCV1 coverage was 59.9% by age 9 months and 76.3% by age 12 months, and MCV2 was 33.0% by age 15 months and 44.8% by age 24 months. MCV coverage was generally higher in urban compared to rural areas. Among vaccinated children, the proportion receiving early, timely, and delayed doses was 30.1%, 44.5%, and 25.3% for MCV1, and 28.6%, 41.2%, and 30.3% for MCV2, respectively. Characteristics associated with timely MCV1 vaccination differed in urban and rural areas, but common themes included increased caregiver immunization awareness and service delivery aspects. Conclusions Although most children who received MCV1 were vaccinated by 12 months, many received delayed doses. MCV2 coverage was low, irrespective of vaccination timing. Findings highlight the importance of routine catch-up vaccination policies and guidance, and the need for tailored strategies in urban and rural settings to improve MCV coverage and timely vaccination.

A secondary analysis of a 2021 cross-sectional household survey of children aged 12–35 months was conducted. The study found that MCV1 coverage was 59.9% by age 9 months and 76.3% by age 12 months, while MCV2 coverage was 33.0% by age 15 months and 44.8% by age 24 months. papers.abstract_zh: 背景 延迟 麻疹 与含 麻疹 的 疫苗(MCV1、MCV2)的首剂/次剂量会增加 麻疹 传播 的风险。MCV2 于 2019 年被添加到埃塞俄比亚的常规免疫计划中,在 15 个月大时接种。我们描述了 麻疹 疫苗接种 的年龄以及与 MCV2 引入后及时 疫苗接种 相关的特征。方法 对 2021 年埃塞俄比亚奥罗米亚州 12-35 个月龄儿童进行的横断面家庭调查进行了二次分析。MCV 疫苗接种 状态和 疫苗接种 年龄是根据孩子的 疫苗接种 卡确定的。估计了按 疫苗接种 年龄划分的 MCV1 和 MCV2(24-35 个月儿童)的累积卡确认 疫苗接种 覆盖率。在接受 MCV 的儿童中,疫苗接种 时间分为早期(MCV1:<9 个月;MCV2:<15 个月)、及时(MCV1:9 至 <10 个月;MCV2:15 至 <16 个月)或延迟(MCV1:≥10 个月;MCV2:≥16 个月)。使用多元逻辑回归和城市/农村分层分析与及时 MCV1 疫苗接种 相关的特征。结果 总体而言,对 651 名 12-35 个月的儿童 (MCV1) 和 270 名 24-35 个月的儿童 (MCV2) 进行了分析。9 个月时的累积 MCV1 覆盖率为 59.9%,12 个月时为 76.3%,15 个月时的 MCV2 累积覆盖率为 33.0%,24 个月时为 44.8%。与农村地区相比,城市地区的 MCV 覆盖率普遍较高。接种儿童中,MCV1 早期接种、及时接种和延迟接种比例分别为 30.1%、44.5% 和 25.3%,MCV2 接种比例分别为 28.6%、41.2% 和 30.3%。与及时 MCV1 疫苗接种 相关的特征在城市和农村地区有所不同,但共同主题包括护理人员免疫意识和服务提供方面的提高。结论 虽然大多数接受 MCV1 的儿童在 12 个月大时就接种了疫苗,但许多人接受了延迟剂量。无论 疫苗接种 时间如何,MCV2 覆盖率都很低。研究结果强调了常规追赶疫苗接种政策和指导的重要性,以及在城乡环境中制定量身定制的策略以提高MCV覆盖率和及时疫苗接种的必要性。

papers.title: Measles Vaccination and Epidemics in Mbujimayi, Democratic Republic of Congo : A Qualitative Study
papers.abstract: Abstract Introduction : Measles is a highly contagious viral disease caused by a morbillivirus, primarily affecting children under five years of age. It remains a significant public health problem in our community, our province, and in many countries across Africa and the world, despite the availability of an effective vaccine. The overall objective is to contribute to reducing measles morbidity and mortality by documenting the factors that influence the persistence of measles in the community. Methodology : Our qualitative study was conducted using semi-structured interviews with healthcare providers and focus groups with parents of children. Data analysis was performed using Atlas Ti software. Results : The majority of parents are familiar with measles, its symptoms, transmission methods, and treatment; they also understand the importance of vaccination. Some parents believe that measles is a curse placed on the child and prefer traditional remedies. Healthcare providers recommend medical care and measles vaccination, adhering to the full vaccination schedule. Some religions reject vaccines in the name of their faith or miracles, ultimately creating pockets of resistance. Conclusion : Support from the national and provincial health systems through the Expanded Program on Immunization (EPI) is essential. It is crucial to avoid non-compliance with the vaccination schedule, vaccine stockouts, and adherence to the cold chain.

papers.title: SVIR Model Analysis of Measles with Incomplete Vaccination and 1 Waning Immunity: Sidoarjo-Indonesia Case
papers.abstract: Measles remains a significant public health challenge in Indonesia, especially in regionswith heterogeneous vaccination coverage and waning immunity. This study develops andanalyzes a Susceptible–Vaccinated–Infected–Recovered (SVIR) compartmental model formeasles transmission in Sidoarjo City, Indonesia, incorporating waning immunity. The basicreproduction number R0 is derived using the next-generation matrix method, and the globalstability of both the disease-free and endemic equilibria is rigorously proven via Lyapunovfunctions. Model parameters are estimated from weekly 2023 surveillance data in Sidoarjo Cityusing Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), Extended Kalman Filter, Maximum LikelihoodEstimation, and Least Squares, and evaluated via Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE).PSO achieves the lowest MAPE (11.17%), outperforming the other methods. The estimatedR0 = 0.668confirms a disease-free regime. Normalized sensitivity analysis identifies vaccineefficacy as the most influential parameter; a decline in efficacy to0 .75elevates R0 close tothe critical threshold, and any further reduction pushes the system into an endemic state.These findings underscore the necessity of maintaining high vaccine efficacy through boosterprograms and strengthened immunization strategies to sustain measles elimination at thedistrict level.
papers.journal: CAUCHY: Jurnal Matematika Murni dan Aplikasi

papers.title: Demographic and Clinical Characteristics of Adult Measles Patients Attending a Tertiary Care Hospital in Bangladesh
papers.abstract: Background: Measles remains a leading vaccine-preventable cause of morbidity, and epidemiological drift toward older age groups has increasingly placed adolescents and adults at risk of severe disease in settings with incomplete immunisation coverage. Objective: This study characterises the demographic profile, clinical presentation, laboratory findings, complications and in-hospital outcomes of adult measles patients (18–65 years) managed at a Bangladeshi tertiary centre. Methods: A hospital-based cross-sectional study enrolled 108 clinically diagnosed measles patients aged 18–65 years, admitted to the Department of Medicine, Rajshahi Medical College Hospital, between March and July 2026. Demographic, clinical, virological and biochemical variables were recorded prospectively. Data were analysed in SPSS v26.0 using descriptive statistics, the chi-square test and independent-samples t-tests, with p < 0.05 considered significant. Results: The mean age was 22.2 ± 12.6 years (range 1–45); patients were distributed across the 18–30 (42, 38.9%), 31–45 (35, 32.4%), 46–55 (20, 18.5%) and 56–65 (11, 10.2%) year bands, and 60 (55.6%) were female. Only 29 (26.9%) were fully vaccinated, whereas 35 (32.4%) were unvaccinated. Measles-specific IgM was positive in 51 patients (47.2%). The mean peak temperature was 39.6 ± 0.8 °C and mean C-reactive protein 57.2 ± 34.0 mg/L. Pneumonia occurred in 50 patients (46.3%) and 2 (1.9%) required intensive care. Overall, 97 patients (89.8%) recovered, 9 (8.3%) were referred and 2 (1.9%) died. Conclusion: A predominance of incompletely immunised adult patients with a notable complication burden underscores persistent immunity gaps and the need for catch-up vaccination and strengthened surveillance, even though intensive-care requirement and case-fatality in this cohort were low.

papers.title_zh: 孟加拉国三级护理医院就诊的成人 麻疹 患者的人口统计学和临床​​特征
papers.source_body_en: Background: Measles remains a leading vaccine-preventable cause of morbidity, and epidemiological drift toward older age groups has increasingly placed adolescents and adults at risk of severe disease in settings with incomplete immunisation coverage. Objective: This study characterises the demographic profile, clinical presentation, laboratory findings, complications and in-hospital outcomes of adult measles patients (18–65 years) managed at a Bangladeshi tertiary centre. Methods: A hospital-based cross-sectional study enrolled 108 clinically diagnosed measles patients aged 18–65 years, admitted to the Department of Medicine, Rajshahi Medical College Hospital, between March and July 2026. Demographic, clinical, virological and biochemical variables were recorded prospectively. Data were analysed in SPSS v26.0 using descriptive statistics, the chi-square test and independent-samples t-tests, with p < 0.05 considered significant. Results: The mean age was 22.2 ± 12.6 years (range 1–45); patients were distributed across the 18–30 (42, 38.9%), 31–45 (35, 32.4%), 46–55 (20, 18.5%) and 56–65 (11, 10.2%) year bands, and 60 (55.6%) were female. Only 29 (26.9%) were fully vaccinated, whereas 35 (32.4%) were unvaccinated. Measles-specific IgM was positive in 51 patients (47.2%). The mean peak temperature was 39.6 ± 0.8 °C and mean C-reactive protein 57.2 ± 34.0 mg/L. Pneumonia occurred in 50 patients (46.3%) and 2 (1.9%) required intensive care. Overall, 97 patients (89.8%) recovered, 9 (8.3%) were referred and 2 (1.9%) died. Conclusion: A predominance of incompletely immunised adult patients with a notable complication burden underscores persistent immunity gaps and the need for catch-up vaccination and strengthened surveillance, even though intensive-care requirement and case-fatality in this cohort were low.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景:麻疹 仍然是导致 麻疹 可预防的主要发病原因,并且流行病学向老年群体的漂移越来越多地使青少年和成年人在免疫覆盖不完全的环境中面临严重疾病的风险。目的:本研究描述了孟加拉国三级中心管理的成年 麻疹 患者(18-65 岁)的人口统计学特征、临床表现、实验室检查结果、并发症和住院结果。方法:一项以医院为基础的横断面研究纳入了 2026 年 3 月至 7 月入住 Rajshahi 医学院医院内科的 108 名临床诊断的 麻疹 患者,年龄为 18-65 岁。前瞻性记录人口统计学、临床、病毒学和生化变量。使用描述性统计、卡方检验和独立样本 t 检验在 SPSS v26.0 中对数据进行分析,p < 0.05 被认为是显着的。结果:平均年龄为 22.2 ± 12.6 岁(范围 1-45);患者分布在18-30岁(42岁,38.9%)、31-45岁(35岁,32.4%)、46-55岁(20岁,18.5%)和56-65岁(11岁,10.2%)年龄段,其中60岁(55.6%)为女性。只有 29 人(26.9%)完全接种了疫苗,而 35 人(32.4%)未接种疫苗。51 名患者 (47.2%) 中 麻疹 特异性 IgM 呈阳性。平均峰值温度为 39.6 ± 0.8 °C,平均 C 反应蛋白为 57.2 ± 34.0 mg/L。50 名患者(46.3%)发生肺炎,其中 2 名患者(1.9%)需要重症监护。总体而言,97 名患者 (89.8%) 康复,9 名患者 (8.3%) 转诊,2 名患者 (1.9%) 死亡。结论:大多数未完全免疫的成年患者具有显着的并发症负担,这强调了持续的免疫差距以及追赶 疫苗接种 和加强 监测 的需要,尽管该 队列研究 的重症监护需求和病死率较低。

papers.title: Insights on United States cumulative measles cases during the 2026 outbreak using ARIMA and generalized linear models
papers.abstract: To understand the nature of the current measles outbreaks taking place across the United States in 2026, we analyzed historical surveillance data dating back to 1997 using four distinct forecasting models. By withholding data from the first four months of 2026 for out-of-sample validation, we evaluated how well traditional trend tracking and temporal dependence could anticipate this year's trajectory. While models incorporating short-term patterns performed best overall, every single model underestimated the cumulative cases recorded by May 1, 2026. This systematic underprediction reveals that the ongoing resurgence cannot be explained merely as a continuation of past trends or 2025 outbreak effects. Instead, 2026 represents a distinct, more severe outbreak regime, as the projected annual burden was already reached by May. These findings indicate that public health tracking must adapt to this heightened risk environment, and warn that the final 2026 case burden will substantially exceed that of previous years.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究分析了 1997 年至 2025 年的历史 监测 数据,并保留了 2026 年前四个月的数据以进行样本外验证。重点是美国和 2026 年发生的 麻疹 暴发。
elements_zh.methods: 作者使用四种不同的预测模型来分析历史 监测 数据,包括 ARIMA 和广义线性模型,以评估它们预测 2026 年 麻疹 暴发 轨迹的能力。他们保留了 2026 年前四个月的数据来验证模型的性能。
elements_zh.main_results: 每个模型都低估了截至 2026 年 5 月 1 日记录的累积 麻疹 病例。系统性低估表明 2026 年 麻疹 不能仅仅解释为过去趋势的延续或 2025 年 暴发 的影响。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,2026年的麻疹 暴发代表了一种与往年不同的、更为严重的流行态势,因为预计的年度负担已于2026年5月1日就已实现。这表明暴发的动态发生了变化,需要更新公共卫生策略。

analysis_en.study_design_and_population: The study analyzed historical surveillance data from 1997 to 2025, with data from the first four months of 2026 withheld for out-of-sample validation. The focus was on the United States and the measles outbreaks occurring during the year 2026.

analysis_en.main_results: Every single model underestimated the cumulative measles cases recorded by May 1, 2026. The systematic underprediction suggests that the 2026 outbreak cannot be explained merely as a continuation of past trends or the effects of the 2025 outbreak.

papers.source_body_en: To understand the nature of the current measles outbreaks taking place across the United States in 2026, we analyzed historical surveillance data dating back to 1997 using four distinct forecasting models. By withholding data from the first four months of 2026 for out-of-sample validation, we evaluated how well traditional trend tracking and temporal dependence could anticipate this year's trajectory. While models incorporating short-term patterns performed best overall, every single model underestimated the cumulative cases recorded by May 1, 2026. This systematic underprediction reveals that the ongoing resurgence cannot be explained merely as a continuation of past trends or 2025 outbreak effects. Instead, 2026 represents a distinct, more severe outbreak regime, as the projected annual burden was already reached by May. These findings indicate that public health tracking must adapt to this heightened risk environment, and warn that the final 2026 case burden will substantially exceed that of previous years.

papers.title: Epidemiological Pattern and Clinical Outcomes of Measles among Children Managed at Modibbo Adama University Teaching Hospital, Yola, North-East Nigeria: A Retrospective Study
papers.abstract: Measles is a vaccine-preventable disease that continues to cause substantial childhood morbidity and mortality in Nigeria, particularly in the north, where vaccination coverage remains suboptimal, population displacement is widespread, and access to healthcare is limited. Objectives: This study aimed to describe the epidemiological pattern, vaccination status, clinical complications, and outcomes of measles among children managed at Modibbo Adama University Teaching Hospital (MAUTHY), Yola, Adamawa State, North-East Nigeria. Methods: A retrospective cross-sectional study was conducted among 22 children aged 1 month to 17 years admitted with clinical measles between January and December 2025. Data were extracted from medical records using a structured form and analysed with IBM SPSS Statistics version 21; Fisher’s exact test was used for categorical associations (p < 0.05). Results and Discussion: Children under five years accounted for 86.4% of admissions; children aged 1–4 years formed the largest age group (54.5%). Sex distribution was equal. Most children (81.8%) were unvaccinated or incompletely vaccinated. A marked seasonal peak occurred in March–April, accounting for 68.2% of cases and all deaths. Bronchopneumonia (90.9%), severe acute malnutrition (81.8%), and diarrhoea (68.1%) were the commonest complications. Six children died, yielding a case fatality rate of 27.3%; four deaths occurred within 24 hours of admission. No statistically significant association was detected between age group and outcome (p = 1.000). Conclusion: Measles imposes a severe, preventable burden on children in Adamawa State. Strengthening routine immunization, nutritional support, and early care-seeking behaviour are essential priorities.

Objectives: This study aimed to describe the epidemiological pattern, vaccination status, clinical complications, and outcomes of measles among children managed at Modibbo Adama University Teaching Hospital (MAUTHY), Yola, Adamawa State, North-East Nigeria. Methods: A retrospective cross-sectional study was conducted among 22 children aged 1 month to 17 years admitted with clinical measles between January and December 2025. Data were extracted from medical records using a structured form and analysed with IBM SPSS Statistics version 21; Fisher’s exact test was used for categorical associations (p < 0.05). Results and Discussion: Children under five years accounted for 86.4% of admissions; children aged 1–4 years formed the largest age group (54.5%). Sex distribution was equal. Most children (81.8%) were unvaccinated or incompletely vaccinated. A marked seasonal peak occurred in March–April, accounting for 68.2% of cases and all deaths. Bronchopneumonia (90.9%), severe acute malnutrition (81.8%), and diarrhoea (68.1%) were the commonest complications. Six children died, yielding a case fatality rate of 27.3%; four deaths occurred within 24 hours of admission. No statistically significant association was detected between age group and outcome (p = 1.000). Conclusion: Measles imposes a severe, preventable burden on children in Adamawa State. Strengthening routine immunization, nutritional support, and early care-seeking behaviour are essential priorities.
papers.abstract_zh: 麻疹 是一种 疫苗 可预防疾病,在尼日利亚,特别是在北部,死亡率 继续导致大量儿童发病,死亡率 的覆盖率仍然不理想,人口流离失所现象普遍,获得医疗保健的机会有限。目的:本研究旨在描述尼日利亚东北部阿达玛瓦州约拉市莫迪博阿达玛大学教学医院 (MAUTHY) 管理的儿童中 麻疹 的流行病学模式、麻疹 状态、临床并发症和结果。方法:对 2025 年 1 月至 12 月因临床 麻疹 入院的 22 名 1 个月至 17 岁儿童进行回顾性横断面研究。使用结构化表格从病历中提取数据,并使用 IBM SPSS Statistics 21 版进行分析;Fisher 精确检验用于分类关联(p < 0.05)。结果与讨论:五岁以下儿童占入院儿童的86.4%;1-4岁儿童是最大的年龄组(54.5%)。性别分布是平等的。大多数儿童(81.8%)未接种疫苗或疫苗接种不完全。3 月至 4 月是明显的季节性高峰,占病例和死亡总数的 68.2%。支气管肺炎(90.9%)、严重急性营养不良(81.8%)和腹泻(68.1%)是最常见的并发症。6名儿童死亡,病死率为27.3%;入院 24 小时内发生 4 例死亡。年龄组和结果之间没有检测到统计学上显着的关联(p = 1.000)。结论:麻疹 给阿达马瓦州的儿童带来了严重的、可预防的负担。加强常规免疫、营养支持和早期就医行为是重要的优先事项。

papers.title: Measles Immunoglobulin G Positivity and Associated Factors Among Suspected Cases in Three Selected Zambian Provinces: A Bayesian Logistic Regression Study
papers.abstract: Measles remains a public-health concern where immunity gaps and incomplete vaccination coverage persist. This study assessed household and geographic factors associated with laboratory-confirmed measles among suspected cases in three Zambian provinces. A prospective cross-sectional study was conducted during measles outbreaks in five selected districts across Luapula, Northern and Northwestern provinces. Suspected cases meeting the IDSR case definition were consecutively enrolled. Blood samples were collected, transported to the UTH Virology Laboratory, and tested using procured IgG test kits. Participant characteristics were summarised descriptively. Bayesian logistic regression estimated associations between laboratory-confirmed (IgG positive) measles and age, sex, vaccination status, household size and previous measles history, with province added in a second model. Results were reported as posterior odds ratios with 95% credible intervals. Among the 172 suspected cases, 45 (26.2%) were laboratory confirmed (IgG positive). Vaccination status was verified using caregiver-provided immunization cards; status was unknown for 110 (64.0%) participants (all of whom tested negative), reflecting missing vaccination documentation. Vaccinated participants had 93% lower adjusted odds of laboratory-confirmed measles than unvaccinated participants (adjusted posterior OR: 0.07, 95% CrI: 0.02–0.18). Adjusted posterior probabilities were consistently lower among vaccinated participants across all three provinces (34% to 49%) than among unvaccinated participants (86% to 92%). Age, sex and household size were not clearly associated with measles positivity. All four participants reporting a previous measles history tested positive, and the unadjusted association was significant using Fisher’s exact test (p = 0.004). Vaccination status was most strongly associated with laboratory-confirmed measles, with substantially lower adjusted odds among vaccinated participants. These findings reinforce the importance of measles vaccination in outbreak prevention and control.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Measles remains a public-health concern where immunity gaps and incomplete vaccination coverage persist. This study aimed to assess factors associated with laboratory-confirmed measles among suspected cases.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A prospective cross-sectional study was conducted during measles outbreaks in five selected districts across Luapula, Northern and Northwestern provinces. Among the 172 suspected cases, 45 (26.2%) were laboratory confirmed (IgG positive). Suspected cases meeting the IDSR case definition were consecutively enrolled.
analysis.methods: Blood samples were collected, transported to the UTH Virology Laboratory, and tested using procured IgG test kits. Bayesian logistic regression estimated associations between laboratory-confirmed (IgG positive) measles and age, sex, vaccination status, household size and previous measles history, with province added in a second model.
analysis.main_results: Vaccinated participants had 93% lower adjusted odds of laboratory-confirmed measles than unvaccinated participants (adjusted posterior OR: 0.07, 95% CrI: 0.02–0.18). Adjusted posterior probabilities were consistently lower among vaccinated participants across all three provinces (34% to 49%) than among unvaccinated participants (86% to 92%).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study found that vaccination status was most strongly associated with laboratory-confirmed measles, with substantially lower adjusted odds among vaccinated participants. These findings reinforce the importance of measles vaccination in outbreak prevention and control.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings highlight the critical role of measles vaccination in preventing and controlling outbreaks, which can inform public health strategies for improving vaccination coverage and surveillance.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study relied on caregiver-provided immunization cards, which may introduce bias due to missing documentation. The evidence is moderate as it is based on a cross-sectional design and limited to outbreak settings.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated factors associated with laboratory-confirmed measles among suspected cases in three Zambian provinces. It found that vaccination status was strongly linked to measles positivity, with vaccinated participants having 93% lower odds of confirmation compared to unvaccinated individuals. The study used Bayesian logistic regression to estimate these associations, highlighting the importance of vaccination in outbreak prevention. However, the reliance on caregiver-reported vaccination data and the cross-sectional design limit the strength of the evidence. The results suggest that improving vaccination documentation and coverage could enhance measles control efforts.

analysis_zh.methods: 收集血样,运送至 UTH 病毒学实验室,并使用采购的 IgG 检测试剂盒进行检测。贝叶斯逻辑回归估计了实验室确诊(IgG 阳性)麻疹 与年龄、性别、麻疹 状态、家庭规模和既往 麻疹 历史之间的关联,并在第二个模型中添加了省份。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究发现,麻疹 状态与实验室确认的 麻疹 密切相关,接种疫苗的参与者中调整后的几率要低得多。这些发现强化了麻疹 疫苗接种在暴发预防和控制中的重要性。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调了 麻疹 疫苗接种 在预防和控制 暴发 中的关键作用,这可以为提高 疫苗接种 覆盖率和 监测 的公共卫生策略提供信息。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究依赖于护理人员提供的免疫卡,这可能会因文件缺失而产生偏差。证据是中等的,因为它基于横截面设计并且仅限于 暴发 设置。

analysis.research_question_and_background: Measles, mumps, and rubella outbreaks continue to occur despite high vaccination coverage, raising concerns about long-term vaccine-induced immunity. This study assessed serological protection against measles, mumps, rubella, and varicella in fully vaccinated Russian adolescents to identify immunity gaps and inform revaccination strategies.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This study was a cross-sectional study conducted in Russia among adolescents with documented two-dose MMR vaccination. The study aimed to evaluate seroprevalence of IgG antibodies against measles, mumps, rubella, and varicella in this population.
analysis.methods: Serum IgG was quantified by commercial ELISA. Analytical cut-offs were: measles ≥ 0.18 IU/mL, rubella ≥ 30 IU/mL, mumps index ≥ 1.0 (index = OD/0.467), and varicella ≥ 1.0 IU/mL; equivocal results were classified as negative in the primary analysis and as positive in a sensitivity analysis. Geometric mean concentrations (GMC) were computed on the natural-logarithm scale.
analysis.main_results: Seropositivity differed markedly between infections (χ2 55.1; p.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study highlights the importance of monitoring vaccine-induced immunity in adolescents to identify potential gaps and guide revaccination strategies.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform public health strategies for maintaining immunity against measles, mumps, rubella, and varicella in vaccinated populations, particularly in regions with high vaccination coverage.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its cross-sectional design and the potential for equivocal results to affect seropositivity classification. The evidence is moderate due to the reliance on serological data without longitudinal follow-up.

analysis.summary_en: This cross-sectional study evaluated serological protection against measles, mumps, rubella, and varicella in fully vaccinated Russian adolescents. Despite high vaccination coverage, the study found marked differences in seropositivity between infections, raising concerns about long-term immunity. The findings suggest the need for monitoring vaccine-induced immunity and may inform revaccination strategies. The study used commercial ELISA to quantify IgG antibodies and set specific analytical cut-offs for each infection. However, the cross-sectional design and classification of equivocal results limit the confidence in the findings, resulting in moderate evidence strength.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 尽管 麻疹 覆盖率很高,但 麻疹、腮腺炎和风疹 暴发 仍在继续发生,这引起了人们对 疫苗 长期诱导免疫的担忧。这项研究评估了完全接种疫苗的俄罗斯青少年对 麻疹、腮腺炎、风疹和水痘的血清学保护作用,以确定免疫差距并为重新接种策略提供信息。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项研究是在俄罗斯对记录有两剂 MMR 疫苗接种 的青少年进行的一项横断面研究。该研究旨在评估该人群中针对 麻疹、腮腺炎、风疹和水痘的 IgG 抗体 血清流行率。
elements_zh.methods: 血清 IgG 通过商业 ELISA 进行定量。分析临界值为:麻疹 ≥ 0.18 IU/mL、风疹 ≥ 30 IU/mL、腮腺炎指数 ≥ 1.0(指数 = OD/0.467)和水痘 ≥ 1.0 IU/mL;模棱两可的结果在初步分析中被分类为阴性,在敏感性分析中被分类为阳性。几何平均浓度(GMC)以自然对数尺度计算。
elements_zh.main_results: 感染之间的血清阳性率存在显着差异(χ2 55.1;p. 1)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究强调了监测青少年 疫苗 诱导的免疫力以发现潜在差距并指导重新接种策略的重要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为疫苗接种人群中维持对麻疹、流行性腮腺炎、风疹和水痘的免疫力的公共卫生策略提供信息,特别是在疫苗接种覆盖率较高的地区。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到横断面设计的限制,且可能产生模棱两可的结果,从而影响血清阳性分类。由于依赖血清学数据而缺乏纵向随访,证据强度中等。

papers.title: Co-detection of measles virus vaccine strain and seasonal coronavirus in an immunocompromised patient with pneumonia
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Background Measles vaccination is recommended for hematopoietic stem cell transplant (HSCT) recipients ≥24 months post-transplant in the absence of graft-versus-host disease and immunosuppressive therapy. Administration of live vaccines during immunosuppression may result in iatrogenic injury. Case Summary We describe a 76-year-old patient with stage 3 multiple myeloma who had undergone autologous HSCT and received multiple therapies, including chimeric antigen receptor T-cell therapy and recent daratumumab treatment. Approximately 1 month after measles, mumps, and rubella (MMR) vaccination, she presented with progressive respiratory symptoms and hypoxia. Despite broad-spectrum antimicrobials and supportive care, her condition deteriorated, requiring ICU admission and mechanical ventilation. Molecular testing of her bronchoalveolar fluid detected the measles virus vaccine strain and seasonal coronavirus OC63. The patient succumbed to her illness on hospital day 16. Conclusion This case highlights the rare but severe complication of measles vaccine-associated pneumonia in an immunocompromised host. While guidelines support MMR vaccination ≥24 months post-HSCT, ongoing immunosuppression may increase susceptibility to vaccine-related adverse events. Rising measles incidence in North America underscores the need for individualized vaccination strategies, balancing infection risk and vaccine safety. Healthcare providers should exercise caution when considering live-attenuated vaccines in HSCT recipients with recent immunosuppressive therapy. Further research is needed to refine vaccination guidelines for this vulnerable population.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在强调免疫功能低下的 麻疹 疫苗 相关肺炎的罕见但严重的并发症,特别是那些接受过造血干细胞移植 (HSCT) 并正在接受免疫抑制治疗的患者。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 病例报告 是在一名 76 岁 3 期多发性骨髓瘤患者中进行的,该患者接受了自体 HSCT 并接受了多种治疗,包括嵌合抗原受体 T 细胞治疗和最近的 daratumumab 治疗。该研究于 2025 年至 2026 年间在一家医院进行。
elements_zh.methods: 患者接受了 麻疹、腮腺炎和风疹 (MMR) 疫苗 治疗,并在 麻疹 治疗后约 1 个月对支气管肺泡液进行分子检测,以检测 麻疹病毒 疫苗 菌株和季节性冠状病毒 OC63 的存在。
elements_zh.main_results: 支气管肺泡液的分子检测检测到 麻疹病毒 疫苗 菌株和季节性冠状病毒 OC63。尽管使用了广谱抗菌药物和支持治疗,患者的病情仍然恶化,需要入住 ICU 并使用机械通气,最终在住院第 16 天去世。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将此病例解读为强调了免疫功能低下个体(甚至是 HSCT 后 24 个月以上接受 疫苗 治疗的个体)发生 麻疹 疫苗 相关肺炎的可能性。该病例的新颖性在于证明了在单个患者中同时检测到 麻疹病毒 疫苗 毒株和季节性冠状病毒。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调了对免疫功能低下的 HSCT 受者(尤其是最近接受免疫抑制治疗的受者)采取谨慎的 疫苗接种 策略的重要性,并表明需要进一步研究来完善 疫苗 在该人群中的安全性指南。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于单个病例报告,可能无法推广。该证据基于分子测试和临床观察,由于缺乏更广泛的数据,研究结果的可信度中等。

analysis.summary_en: This study explores the use of importation pressure and surveillance traceability as complementary indicators for sustaining measles elimination in the Americas. The authors argue that these two metrics, when combined, provide a more robust framework for monitoring and maintaining measles elimination status. The findings suggest that such an integrated approach can enhance public health strategies by offering a clearer picture of disease dynamics and control effectiveness. The study is based on abstract-level evidence and relies on surveillance data, which may limit the depth of analysis. However, the proposed indicators are relevant for improving measles surveillance and prevention efforts. The authors highlight the novelty of combining these two factors to support elimination goals, though the evidence is not detailed enough to fully assess their impact. The study contributes to the understanding of how to sustain measles elimination through improved monitoring systems.

papers.title: The 2026 Measles Outbreak in Bangladesh: A Critique of Immunity Gaps and Care Deficiencies
papers.abstract: Bangladesh entered 2026 amid a severe measles outbreak that peaked in mid-May. This article analyses the public health response to the outbreak and evaluates the government's management of the crisis. Health professionals and measles experts have attributed the outbreak to accumulated gaps in routine immunisation, weaknesses in public health infrastructure, poor nutritional status among children, widespread vitamin A deficiency, and maternal undernutrition during pregnancy and breastfeeding.

papers.title: Age-related BAX and Ki-67 Expression in Regional Lymph Nodes of Infants who Died from Measles: A Retrospective Immunohistochemical Study
papers.abstract: Background: Measles can produce substantial lymphoid tissue injury and immunosuppression, but age-related patterns of apoptotic and proliferative activity in regional lymph nodes during fatal measles in infancy remain insufficiently characterised. Aims: To evaluate age-related changes in BAX and Ki-67 immunohistochemical expression in regional lymph nodes of infants who died from measles. Study Design: A retrospective morphological and immunohistochemical study of archived autopsy specimens. Methodology: Regional lymph node specimens from 83 infants were examined. The study groups were ≤1 month (n=18), 2–6 months (n=42), and 6–12 months (n=23); the ≤1-month group was further divided into early and late neonatal subgroups. Paraffin-embedded sections were evaluated histologically and by immunohistochemistry using the streptavidin–biotin peroxidase method with diaminobenzidine visualisation and haematoxylin counterstaining. BAX was assessed using the Immunoreactive Score, whereas Ki-67 was assessed using the H-score method. Results: BAX immunoreactivity was detected in all age groups. Moderate expression occurred in both neonatal subgroups and the 6–12-month group, while strong expression occurred in the 2–6-month group. Ki-67 immunoreactivity was present in lymphoid and stromal populations, with moderate lymphocyte expression at 2–6 months and the most pronounced overall expression at 6–12 months. Conclusion: Fatal measles in infancy was associated with age-related differences in BAX and Ki-67 expression, indicating differing patterns of pro-apoptotic and proliferative activity across the examined age groups.
papers.journal: Journal of Advances in Medicine and Medical Research

Study Design: A retrospective morphological and immunohistochemical study of archived autopsy specimens. Methodology: Regional lymph node specimens from 83 infants were examined. The study groups were ≤1 month (n=18), 2–6 months (n=42), and 6–12 months (n=23); the ≤1-month group was further divided into early and late neonatal subgroups. Paraffin-embedded sections were evaluated histologically and by immunohistochemistry using the streptavidin–biotin peroxidase method with diaminobenzidine visualisation and haematoxylin counterstaining. BAX was assessed using the Immunoreactive Score, whereas Ki-67 was assessed using the H-score method. Results: BAX immunoreactivity was detected in all age groups. Moderate expression occurred in both neonatal subgroups and the 6–12-month group, while strong expression occurred in the 2–6-month group. Ki-67 immunoreactivity was present in lymphoid and stromal populations, with moderate lymphocyte expression at 2–6 months and the most pronounced overall expression at 6–12 months. Conclusion: Fatal measles in infancy was associated with age-related differences in BAX and Ki-67 expression, indicating differing patterns of pro-apoptotic and proliferative activity across the examined age groups.

The research highlights the need to better understand immunological changes during fatal measles in infancy. A retrospective immunohistochemical analysis of 83 archived autopsy specimens revealed varying levels of BAX and Ki-67 expression across different age groups. The results suggest that age influences apoptotic and proliferative activity in lymph nodes during measles infection. These findings may contribute to improved surveillance and targeted interventions for measles in infants. However, the study's retrospective nature and reliance on archived specimens limit the confidence in its conclusions, resulting in a moderate assessment of evidence strength.
